title: Open Song Timeline Format (OSTF) 4.2.0
description: OSTF 4.2.0: backward-compatible OSTF 4.1 Core plus optional phonetics, vocal profiles, and vocal performances; instrumental MIDI semantics remain intact.
$comment: OSTF 4.2.0 structural authority. Normative semantics: docs/SPECIFICATION.md and docs/COMPLETE_MANUAL.md. Schema identifiers do not require network retrieval. Native application interoperability is not certified by this specification release.

extensions.description: Optional third-party or verbatim legacy compatibility payloads. Standard Core always remains authoritative. New first-party common information must not be stored only here.

drumKits.description: Optional multiple percussion-kit definitions; absent = no declared kits (3.0 compatible).

contributors.description: Optional unordered identity records referenced by song.credits. No contributor limit is imposed by this format.

midi.description: Optional document-level logical MIDI bus declarations. No physical device or DAW port assignment is encoded.

localizedTitles.description: Optional localized song-title alternatives. song.title is the stable fallback.

description.description: Optional original-language description, including Unicode and line breaks.

credits.description: Ordered credit assignments to contributors. Multiple roles and duplicate contributors permitted.

genres.description: Optional open-ended ordered genre tags; zero or more allowed. Order is authored display preference, first item is primary if a primary label is desired, not a generator weight. Absent means unspecified.

items.description: Authored language tag, preferably BCP 47. Unknown spelling is retained; case-insensitive duplicate tags forbidden.

melodyTrackIds.description: Optional ordered set of tracks explicitly authored as melody-bearing tracks. If present with primaryMelodyTrackId, the primary track must be a member.

localizedNames.description: Optional localized display variants; retain the original name and stable ID. Names never determine track type, routing or identity.

beatGroups.description: Optional additive grouping in denominator units. Values must sum to numerator. Descriptive only; does not change note timestamps.

voicing.description: Optional pitch snapshot (not an arrangement note sequence). No automatic playback.

targets.description: Optional explicit scope. Absence means general timed context, not a global key. Overlapping contexts are not resolved by array order.

localizedNames.description: Optional localized display variants; retain the original name and stable ID. Names never determine track type, routing or identity.

duration.description: Positive note gate in ticks, not the guaranteed audible duration of a one-shot percussion sample.

soundSlotId.description: Document-local Sound Slot ID. Distinct events and IDs stay distinct even if several slots share a MIDI key; a renderer decides the acoustic timbre.

velocity.description: Optional authored note-on velocity for performed Core notes, 1–127; omit to mean unspecified. It is not a note-off velocity, controller stream, chord tone, or a sound-rendering guarantee. Never insert an inferred default when saving.

enabled.description: Optional note-local enable state. Omitted means enabled. False preserves the note but suppresses scheduling/playback; it is distinct from probability=0.

releaseVelocity.description: Optional MIDI Note Off/release velocity, 0-127. Omit when unspecified; readers must not invent and write back a default.

probability.description: Optional note-playback probability from 0.0 to 1.0. Omitted means 1.0. Random sequence identity is not standardized; materialize notes for deterministic interchange.

velocityDeviation.description: Optional note-local velocity variation endpoint relative to velocity. Requires velocity. Semantic rule: velocity + velocityDeviation must remain within 1..127. Omitted means 0.

pitchRole.description: Meaning of a pitch note. musical participates in pitch/harmony/transpose operations; fixedTrigger is an exact MIDI key trigger (for example a keyswitch) and is never transposed or used as musical-pitch evidence. Allowed only on pitch notes.

channel.description: Optional concrete MIDI channel for this performed note. In singleChannel mode it may be omitted and inherited from the track; in multiChannel/MPE mode semantic rules require explicit channel where channel identity matters.

note.description: Concrete Core DAW-note event. The event target is pitch or soundSlotId. Optional 3.5 note-local properties preserve mute, release velocity, probability and velocity variation. pitchRole=fixedTrigger marks a literal MIDI key trigger that must not be musically transposed or analyzed.

localizedNames.description: Optional localized display variants; retain the original name and stable ID. Names never determine track type, routing or identity.

midiEvents.description: Optional clip-local MIDI performance/control events. start is local to the clip and may be negative if absolute time remains nonnegative. Notes remain authoritative in notes[].

vocalPerformances.description: Optional voice-specific phoneme and singing-performance data; references lyrics.voices. Notes/MIDI remain authoritative for MIDI playback.

trackType.description: Semantic event-target category; optional; missing/empty-note tracks may be unknown. It is not a DAW track class.

preferredView.description: Non-binding presentation preference. Does not change note meaning.

soundSource.description: Optional sound-source selection hint, not a plug-in state, preset blob, or sound guarantee.

localizedNames.description: Optional localized display variants; retain the original name and stable ID. Names never determine track type, routing or identity.

drumKitId.description: Optional reference to a declared drumKit; only for a drum/mixed or empty inferred track. All stored slot events in the track must belong to the referenced kit.

directions.description: Optional typed semantic instructions for performance, interpretation, or generation. Uses the global OSTF timebase; it is not a second timeline.

role.description: Optional free-text musical role; not a standardized GM instrument code or an acoustic sample identifier.

midiNote.description: Legacy 3.0 MIDI note hint only; not a GM1 declaration or preview timbre identity.

midiMapping.description: Explicit external MIDI1 output mapping; standard=gm1 is separate from custom even for an equal note number. Not a unique slot or audio identity.

localizedNames.description: Optional localized display variants; retain the original name and stable ID. Names never determine track type, routing or identity.

soundSlot.description: Document-local stable logical percussion target. Equal roles, names or MIDI note mappings never merge distinct slot IDs. No sample/audio identity is encoded.

phonetics.description: Optional alternate phoneme token sequences. Do not alter text/pronunciation. Multiple alphabets are permitted.

voiceId.description: Optional lyricVoice association. When present, aligned units must belong to that voice document and aligned notes must belong to that voice track.

voices.description: Optional explicit vocal-part relationships for multi-voice, harmony and chorus lyrics.

velocityMode.description: independent preserves concrete velocities on refresh; linked requires exact presence/value equality with the template. This field does not trigger refresh on load.

noteStateMode.description: Controls enabled/releaseVelocity/probability/velocityDeviation after materialization. independent preserves concrete note-state values on refresh; linked requires exact presence/value equality with the template. pitchRole is structural and must always remain semantically equal between a source pitch note and its mapped concrete note.

standard.description: gm1=GM Level 1 percussion key 35..81; custom=explicit arbitrary MIDI1 note number.

note.description: MIDI1 note number in 0..127; for gm1 restrict to 35..81.

soundSource.description: Optional informational rendering class or opaque destination hint. In OSTF 4.0, track.midi.busId is the Core logical MIDI routing reference; soundSource does not bind a physical device, plugin state or preset.

identifier.description: Opaque informational target identifier (for example a URI or plug-in identifier), not a physical MIDI-port binding or loading command.

localizedNames.description: Optional translations indexed by a conservative BCP 47 language-tag subset. The original name/title remains authoritative and is never rewritten by locale changes. Case-insensitive duplicate tags are forbidden semantically.

drumKit.description: Optional named ordered membership of global Sound Slot IDs. Does not define plugin preset, sample loading, choke or a kit-local MIDI remapping.

soundSlotIds.description: Ordered, unique references to global soundSlots; may be empty.

voicing.description: Optional informational chord voicing snapshot, not a played Core note collection. Repeated pitches and original array order have meaning for lossless preservation. Per-entry velocity is an optional voicing-preview hint.

pitches.description: Ordered multiset of concrete absolute pitches, 0-127. Duplicates allowed.

velocities.description: Optional positional velocities aligned one-to-one to pitches. Null means unspecified at this index, not 0. Exact equal-length rule is semantic.

contributor.description: One song-local identity; same contributor can receive multiple credit roles. Unicode source name is authoritative.

credit.description: Ordered credit assignment referencing one contributor; role is an open semantic token, not a translated label.

alternateTitle.description: Stable-ID song title alternative; array position and title text do not identify it.

languageMap32.description: Open BCP 47 language-tag dictionary. Schema checks loose subtag structure; full BCP 47 well-formedness and case-insensitive uniqueness are semantic requirements. String may be empty if intentionally blank.

localizationTarget.description: Core target; song is ID-less, all others use global Core ID. No namespace/profile selector.

mode.description: Authored mode identifier. Canonical recognized values include major, minor, dorian, phrygian, lydian, mixolydian, locrian. Unknown values are preserved, never converted to major/minor.

keyChange.description: A change after tick zero; initial key is stored only at song.key. Change at tick 0 is forbidden to prevent dual authority.

mood.description: Authored descriptive mood tag; not a generator preset or a probability.

externalUri.description: Optional external vocabulary URI hint; never authoritative for the authored mood name and never auto-dereferenced.

rightsStatement.description: Authored rights statement only; no rights or permissions are inferred or granted by the format.

grooveIntent.description: Descriptive generation intent only. Never re-apply to already stored notes. unitTicks is one unswung subdivision; two subdivisions form a pair.

generationIntent.description: Portable description of intent, not a promise to reproduce an algorithm. Does not change song.genres or song.moods.

relativePhrases.description: Standard optional Core object under root version 4.0.0, not an extension. Current relationships must be consistent with saved Core; loading never performs editing or generation.

enabled.description: Optional note-local enable state. Omitted means enabled. False preserves the note but suppresses scheduling/playback; it is distinct from probability=0.

releaseVelocity.description: Optional MIDI Note Off/release velocity, 0-127. Omit when unspecified; readers must not invent and write back a default.

probability.description: Optional note-playback probability from 0.0 to 1.0. Omitted means 1.0. Random sequence identity is not standardized; materialize notes for deterministic interchange.

velocityDeviation.description: Optional note-local velocity variation endpoint relative to velocity. Requires velocity. Semantic rule: velocity + velocityDeviation must remain within 1..127. Omitted means 0.

corePhraseSourceNote.description: Template-local source note for phrase materialization. It carries the same note-local 3.5 properties as concrete notes. It is not performed by itself; concrete track notes remain the saved playback events.

provenanceSource.description: Historical source; hashes refer to exact source bytes, not the current document. No automatic retrieval.

provenance.description: Non-executable historical assertions; not composer credits and not a substitute for current metadata. Does not prove authorship or operation correctness.

midiChannel.description: Human-readable MIDI 1.0 channel number 1..16. Wire status-nibble channel = value - 1.

midiBus.description: Document-local logical MIDI destination. Each bus has its own MIDI channel namespace. It is not a physical OS/USB/DAW port binding.

mpeSettings.description: Semantic MPE zone declaration. Lower-zone master is channel 1 and upper-zone master is channel 16; member channels are derived contiguously from memberChannelCount.

trackMidi.description: Optional MIDI channel/routing interpretation for a track. busId is a logical OSTF bus, never a physical MIDI port.

controlChangeEvent.description: MIDI 1.0 Control Change. Controllers 120..127 use channelMode instead.

order.description: Same-tick ordering key. Omitted means 1. Note Off has implicit order 0 and Note On implicit order 2; ties are resolved by the normative ordering rules.

targetNoteId.description: Optional semantic association with an existing concrete note. It does not replace channel/pitch wire semantics.

channelModeEvent.description: MIDI 1.0 Channel Mode message represented separately from ordinary Control Change.

order.description: Same-tick ordering key. Omitted means 1. Note Off has implicit order 0 and Note On implicit order 2; ties are resolved by the normative ordering rules.

programChangeEvent.description: MIDI 1.0 Program Change using the wire data value 0..127. UI may display 1..128.

order.description: Same-tick ordering key. Omitted means 1. Note Off has implicit order 0 and Note On implicit order 2; ties are resolved by the normative ordering rules.

pitchBendEvent.description: MIDI 1.0 14-bit Pitch Bend Change. Bend range is receiver state/RPN data, not encoded in value14.

targetNoteId.description: Optional semantic association with an existing concrete note. It does not replace channel/pitch wire semantics.

value14.description: Raw MIDI 1.0 14-bit pitch-bend value; center is 8192.

lyricVoice.description: Explicit relationship between a vocal/melody track and a lyric document. Several voices may reference the same lyric document without duplicating text.

role.description: Open authored role. Recommended values include lead, harmony, backing, unison, double, counter, adlib, response.

vocalProfile.description: Optional engine-neutral vocal defaults; absence does not mean an instrument voice.

playablePitchRange.description: Authored playable pitch capability in the same 0..127 pitch-number domain as melodic notes. Semantic rule: lowPitch <= highPitch.

directionPitchCollection.description: Direction-local pitch-class collection relative to tonic. It is not a harmonic scale-context object and has no independent timeline identity.

directionPitchSource.description: Source of pitch vocabulary for an improvisation Direction.

instruction.description: Supplemental human/AI-readable semantic instruction. Structured Core parameters remain authoritative.

trackDirection.description: Typed semantic instruction owned by a track and positioned on the OSTF global timebase.

vocalPhonetics.description: Ordered phoneme symbols for a lyric unit, not an absolute pronunciation engine command.

preferred.description: Optional preference only within the same (alphabet, language) set for this lyricUnit. At most one preferred variant per key; absent does not imply false or a guaranteed conversion.

vocalProfile.description: Voice default independent of commercial singer preset or license.

vocalPerformance.description: Performance belonging to exactly one lyric voice within a containing clip.

noteIds.description: Optional exact list of existing note IDs performed by this voice in the containing clip. No duplicate note objects. When present it includes all locally aligned note IDs for that voice. When absent, derive ownership only from voice-specific alignments. Never infer from song.melodyTrackIds.

vocalPhonemeEvent.description: Explicit phoneme timing, expressed in clip-relative ppq ticks, negative allowed with nonnegative absolute song time.

order.description: Optional deterministic ordering when multiple phonemeEvents for one voice share the same start tick; distinct within a (voiceId, start) tie group. Not an audio rendering priority.

value.description: Semitone offset from the targeted MIDI note, in cents (signed).

vocalPitchCurve.description: Specific vocal pitch offset for a single concrete Note, in cents; sample points use clip-relative ppq ticks.

vocalExpressionCurve.description: Portable vocal parameters, each normalized 0..1, with no promise of perceptually identical output across engines.

targetNoteId.description: Optional note-specific replacement of a clip-scoped curve of the same parameter while the note is active. Points still use clip-relative ticks. Do not sum both curves.

vocalTechnique.description: Semantic artistic intention, not deterministic rendering or an extra pitch source.

vocalBreathEvent.description: Optional breath marker. The renderer decides whether to synthesize audible breath.
